newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Mosel plans Samurai bond issue - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mosel plans Samurai bond issue - paper.

text.p: Taiwan's Mosel Vitelic Inc planned to issue 12-15 billion yen worth of Samurai bonds in Japan in June with a coupon rate of below 2.5 percent, the Economic Daily News reported on Saturday.
Mosel officials could not be reached immediately for confirmation.
According to the newspaper, the issue would be underwritten by Nikko Securities and would carry a five-year term.
Mosel, one of Taiwan's leading chipmakers, said on April 28 that it planned to seek a US$320 million syndicated loan to fund a US$1.7 billion wafer venture with Siemens AG.
The newspaper did not say whether Mosel also planned to use the money raised from the Samurai bond issue to fund the venture, called PROMOS Technologies.
